summary: Native Generator Action for text produced by a configured local ACP agent. It is an agent executor, not a Model Provider.

key_files.cards/agent-text.json: Canvas Action Card with an explicit text-to-Document port mapping. Prompt/parameter/reference edits use the native Generator draft editor; empty optional settings select configured defaults at execution.
key_files.generators/text.json: Pinned prompt, harness, optional harness model and system instructions; an optional plain-text Document input collection and one plain-text Document output.
key_files.src/stdio.ts: Reads exact Document bodies through the SDK/Broker and presents them as source material distinct from the request. Calls the invocation-scoped agent.text Host capability and returns a typed Document through the shared SDK. The Host owns sessions, Run admission, output provenance and publication; source heads and Canvas text shadows are never read as substitutes.
